name: Yamuna Shramdaan
gathering: Shramdaan means donated labour. People come to the river and do the unglamorous half of it — clearing, carrying, planting, going home dirty.

holes.what: Which stretch of bank. The record has years and turnout and not one place name, so there is nowhere on this page a reader can go and stand.
holes.unlocks: The ghat or the stretch, for any one of them.

holes.what: How many have run, and when the last one was. Two ran in the spring of 2018 and a much larger one in 2014; that is the end of the written record, not necessarily the end of the Shramdaans.
holes.unlocks: A count, and the date of the most recent. The turnout figures exist in the reports and cannot be published here until the dates behind them do.
